title: Cheat Rule
description: A Semgrep-compatible cheat detection rule with orchestrator-specific metadata. One rule per file. The orchestrator's loader transforms this into a `rules:` Semgrep config when invoking semgrep.

ruleId.description: kebab-case rule identifier; must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.

version.description: Semantic version of this rule's contract.

severity.description: Orchestrator severity. Mapped by the loader onto Semgrep's ERROR/WARNING/INFO when emitting the rule for semgrep itself.

message.description: Human-readable finding message. May contain {{var}} placeholders that the loader leaves intact for Semgrep metavar interpolation.

languages.description: Semgrep language list (e.g. javascript, typescript, python). Loose-typed against Semgrep's accepted set so contributors are not blocked when Semgrep adds new languages.
